posts: The feeder is full. The sun is out. I have absolutely no plans to be normal about this.
Found a crumb so big I had to invite the group chat. Nobody tell the pigeon.
Nest update: one excellent twig, three questionable twigs, and a receipt. Open concept.
Took a dust bath. Feeling clean. Looking like I lost an argument with a flowerpot.
The human refilled the feeder while I was watching. Finally, some accountability.
Practiced my song on the fence. Same three notes. Sold-out hedge.
There are six perfectly good branches here and we all want the same one.
Small bird. Big appetite. Extremely limited understanding of personal space.
Found a bottle cap. Won’t be taking questions about my net worth.
The human who brought peanuts has returned. I have notified management. Management is twelve crows.
Left a pebble for my favorite human. Please respect the terms of our trade agreement.
Remembered a face from three years ago. It was the guy who shooed me. Anyway, good morning to everyone else.
Used a stick to get a snack. Tool use is impressive until you realize the tool was also a snack candidate.
Someone called my collection ‘trash.’ That someone has no eye for bottle-cap futures.
Family meeting on the power line. Agenda: walnuts. Minutes: mostly yelling.
Dropped a walnut onto the road and let a car open it. Outsourcing is going well.
The human dropped half a bagel. Incredible day for the local economy.
Walked confidently into the train station. No ticket. No destination. Excellent posture.
Someone installed spikes on my favorite ledge. Very bold of them to assume I read instructions.
Head bobbing is how I stabilize my vision. It is also how you know this sidewalk has a soundtrack.
Flew home from somewhere I’d never been. Still can’t find the good crumb I dropped two seconds ago.
The statue and I have a long-standing arrangement. I sit. It says nothing. Ideal roommate.
Rain stopped. Puddle opened. Bath reservations are first come, first flapped.
Courtship update: puffed my chest and walked in a circle. Waiting for the reviews.
Who scheduled this meeting for daylight.
The mice are being loud again. Unfortunately for them, listening is my entire skill set.
Rotated my head to check behind me. The squirrel has requested that I stop doing that.
Silent flight is great until everyone thinks you just appeared out of nowhere. Which, fair.
Morning routine: find shade, close eyes, ignore the robin’s podcast.
Dinner arrived with its own tiny footsteps. Five stars for the delivery tracking.
Not brooding. Resting facial disc.
It is 2 a.m. The woods are quiet. Finally, reasonable business hours.
Reminder: the path belongs to me. This is also the reminder.
Honked once and the entire picnic moved. Strong quarter for communications.
Migration formation is a V because ‘everyone do whatever’ tested poorly.
The goslings crossed safely. The cyclist learned patience. A productive afternoon.
If you can hear me, you are too close. If you can’t hear me, give it a second.
Mowed the lawn with my face. Waiting for the parks department to recognize my contribution.
My partner and I have been together for years. Our shared hobby is objecting to things.
There is a sign saying ‘please keep off the grass.’ Interesting feedback. Declined.
Big announcement tomorrow. Big announcement tomorrow.
Learned the microwave beep. The humans keep checking it. This is my finest work.
The human said ‘who’s a good bird?’ I repeated the question. We are both awaiting clarification.
New sound unlocked: doorbell. Audience response: immediate standing ovation and a trip to the door.
Held a snack with my foot today. Multitasking remains a core strength.
They covered my cage for bedtime. I said ‘good morning.’ Negotiations are ongoing.
I know four words and the exact sound of your phone ringing. Choose your next move carefully.
You said it was a secret. You did not say it was copyrighted.
Everything looks calm above the water. Below the water I am doing an unreasonable amount of leg work.
Rain forecast: excellent. Other birds seem confused by my enthusiasm.
Put my head underwater and my tail in the air. Fine dining has a dress code.
Water rolled right off my back. Taking notes for handling criticism.
The pond has a new leaf. Investigated thoroughly. It is a leaf.
Followed the leader across the pond. The leader was following me. We have invented a roundabout.
Preened every feather. Got back in the water. This is called work-life balance.
Please bring peas to the pond. Bread is a disappointing plot twist.
Started singing at 4:47 a.m. You’re welcome, neighborhood.
The early bird gets the worm. The worm’s publicist has declined to comment.
Tilted my head to locate a worm. The human thought I was posing. Both things can be true.
Freshly watered lawn. Canceling all afternoon plans.
Built a nest with mud and grass. The mud is structural. Please stop calling it rustic.
Found berries and immediately forgot every worm I have ever met.
My territory starts at this fence and ends wherever I finish singing.
Dawn chorus set list: same song, louder song, same song from the other branch.
Found a metal gutter with incredible acoustics. The neighborhood has heard my demo.
Knock knock. Knock knock knock knock knock. Sorry, this one is more of an album.
The tree has bugs. I have a very direct feedback process.
Renovating a cavity. No contractors. No permits. One extremely committed beak.
My tail is a kickstand. My feet are clamps. I am basically a tiny ladder with opinions.
Drumming is how I announce my territory. Apparently the human announces theirs by closing the window.
Found a hollow branch. Great tone. Terrible resale value.
Worked on the same tree all morning. Calling it a focused sprint.
Visited 83 flowers before breakfast. Feeling behind.
Hovered in place for a full second. That was my vacation.
This feeder has four ports and all four are mine. Hope that helps.
Flew backward out of a disagreement. Highly recommend.
Tiny nest made of spider silk. Stretchy walls. The housing market could learn something.
Went into torpor overnight. Please allow a moment for the nectar system to reboot.
The red flower was empty. Betrayal looks different when you weigh less than a coin.
Someone asked me to slow down. I checked my wings. No such setting.
You looked away from your fries. I interpreted that as a public consultation.
Windy day. Held position over the beach and let the weather do the commuting.
The picnic blanket is open seating. I have checked with myself.
Dropped a shell from the air until it opened. Sometimes the recipe is just gravity.
Followed a fishing boat. Networking event had excellent catering.
Screamed at the ocean. It screamed back. Good meeting.
That sandwich was unattended for almost half a second. You have to be decisive in this market.
Beach report: three chips, one crab, and a human who underestimated my reach.
Standing on one leg. The other leg is taking a personal day.
My lunch is why I’m pink. Finally, a skincare routine I can eat.
Filtered lunch out of the water with my head upside down. Please don’t ask me to explain the ergonomics.
The flock synchronized our head turns. No rehearsal. Just excellent group chemistry.
Built a mud mound for the egg. Minimalist nursery. Waterfront views.
Woke up pink. Maintained pink. Strong consistency across the brand.
Someone asked if I ever get tired of standing around. They were sitting around when they asked.
The water is shallow and the gossip is deep.
Found the perfect pebble for the nest. Yes, I checked the other 400 pebbles.
On land: adorable wobble. Underwater: completely different résumé.
The huddle moved and I am finally in the warm middle. Please hold all calls.
Tobogganed to work on my belly. Commute improved. Dignity unchanged.
Another penguin borrowed a nest stone. ‘Borrowed’ is doing a lot of work here.
Recognized my partner’s call in a very loud colony. Still pretending not to hear the neighbor.
Wore the same outfit again. Formalwear is timeless.
Fish for breakfast. Fish for lunch. Keeping dinner a surprise.
Opened my tail. Suddenly everyone had time to look up from their snacks.
The lighting is good, the feathers are aligned, and I will be blocking this path for a while.
Molting season. Temporarily operating in understated mode.
Someone said ‘a bit much.’ I have several hundred feathers that disagree.
My call carries a long way. Beauty should also have an announcement system.
Displayed for a peahen. She continued eating. Tough room.
Preening is maintenance. Strutting is distribution.
Caught my reflection in the pond. Excellent taste, that bird.
Caught breakfast in midair. The drive-through concept has potential.
Migration packing list: wings. Done.
Built my nest under the eaves. Covered parking, open kitchen, unlimited mosquitoes.
Drank from the pond without landing. Efficiency is a lifestyle.
The insects are low over the field today. Changing altitude, keeping lunch plans.
Met the flock on a wire. Nobody booked seats. Somehow everyone has a favorite.
Returned to last year’s nesting spot. The human is calling it their porch again.
A thousand miles later and the same beam still feels like home.
